summary: Milestone-8 cascade implementation matches design v5: trace-time gating keeps level-4 paths unchanged (goldens recorded at max |diff| 0, full suite recorded 381 OK / 4 skips); the frozen level-4 stage runs outside the tape in eval mode under float32 behind stop_gradient and never reaches the optimizer; linear Center(R_raw A4) and deform compose_cascade are composed inside the tape with losses on the original batch; BN recalibration is cascade-only (exact parser message), runs once on fresh step 0, never on resume, uses exact c/(c+1) averaging with per-layer momentum restore, and the freeze is re-applied from the saved config; resume decides fresh vs resume once, checks restore and fingerprint, and carries provenance over verbatim; the checker grad_balance rule (ratio of medians, step >= 50, [0.1, 10], INFO only) and both SLURM scripts follow the rules (qtim, 1 GPU, -N 1, 3 CPUs, 64G, logs/results/sif/TMPDIR, stdin closed). Rerun here: py_compile + ast 3.8 on 19 files, bash -n on both scripts, checker + slurm tests 30 OK. Four NITs: design T6 lacks the Grappler-off condition, S_rel_diff_vs_level4 null scope differs from the design, the checker doesn't require _g frozen baselines, possible stale-layer false positive for single-task recalibration. Details in impl-review.md and 2026-10-22-064534-review.md.
